messages.en:
What's the big idea
sending that letter? If
you have a problem with
me, tell me to my face!
messages.et:
Mis mõte oli selle kirja
saatmisel? Kui sul on
minuga probleem, ütle
mulle näkku!

messages.en:
That letter you sent was
so rude! At least I think
it was. It was hard to
tell WHAT you were saying.
messages.et:
See kiri, mille saatsid, oli
nii ebaviisakas! Vähemalt
arvan nii. Oli raske aru
saada, MIDA sa ütlesid.

messages.en:
Writing really isn't your
strong suit. You're better
off hiring a starving poet
to scribble something out.
messages.et:
Kirjutamine pole tõesti
sinu tugev külg. Parem
palka mõni näljane luuletaja
midagi kokku kritseldama.
